title: SAID: Empowering Large Language Models with Self-Activating Internal Defense
reasoning: The paper focuses on jailbreak defense, which is the mechanism for ensuring LLMs adhere to safety and ethical policies. It benchmarks the model's ability to refuse prompts that are harmful, biased, or unethical (such as prompts promoting white supremacy or hacking instructions), which involves evaluating the model's adherence to moral and ethical alignment.
